source.text_version: Complete reused United States national definition; United States national and citizen are not collapsed; complete governed original witness reused from frozen checkpoint 78, with material personal/entity branch qualifications reread for checkpoint 93. No actual listing, ownership or individual status determination.
source.text: (22) The term "national of the United States" means (A) a citizen of the United States, or (B) a person who, though not a citizen of the United States, owes permanent allegiance to the United States.
